profile.headline: Software Engineer | Game Developer
profile.summary: Hello, I'm Anthony. I'm a senior software engineer and self-taught game developer with previous experience at Meta. I have always been inspired by the simple fun and sense of wonder games can bring into peoples lives and I am searching for my next opportunity to work as part of an enthusiastic team bringing these kinds of games to life.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Great Between is an independent video game studio that makes story driven games set in rich atmospheric worlds.
positions.insights: Skills: Game Design · Software Architecture · Software Development

positions.description:

- Learn Unity Engine and C#
